notes.title: Update Notes for v1.23
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug which caused the Pause and Language menus to appear at the same time
- The game will no longer pause if the window loses focus or is minimized

notes.title: Spring Falls v1.2 Released
notes.content:
It's the first day of spring and Spring Falls v1.2 has been released!

This update includes:
• Simplified Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish translations
• Steam Achievements
